name: persian_fa
title: Persian support-triage decisions
task: 4-way choice: which department handles a Persian support message
label_policy: Label = the department that must act on the message's main request. A mentioned-but-negated topic ('I don't want to cancel, just ...') does not set the label. Sarcastic thanks is labelled by the complaint it carries; genuine thanks is 'other'. Stopping auto-renewal or closing/deleting the account is 'cancel'.
provenance: Synthetic messages written for this benchmark, drafted with AI assistance. No real customer data.
